timestamp.description: POSIX epoch timestamp in seconds (100-microsecond resolution) of optical capture

frame_id.description: Monotonic 60Hz frame sequence counter for watchdog heartbeat tracking

gaze_vector.description: Normalized [X, Y, Z] unit vector of user foveal gaze direction in the sensor optical frame

target_xy_normalized.description: Planar workspace intersection coordinates [0.0 - 1.0] mapped to the calibrated homography plane

target_identifier.description: Discrete target interaction zone or service handoff coordinate ID

gaze_locked.description: True when foveal fixation stability satisfies the pre-motor spatio-temporal dwell filter

reach_transit_active.description: True when early ballistic limb kinematics confirm active transit toward the fixated target

measured_lead_time_ms.description: Elapsed pre-motor lead-time buffer (ms) clocked from initial ocular fixation lock to physical boundary entry
